title: Enterprise LLM Structured Outputs, XGrammar FSM Constrained Decoding & Reasoning-First Schema Benchmark

tiers.name: Tier 1: Prompt-Only 'Output Valid JSON' + Regex Strip (No Grammar Mask)
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern: 11.8% JSON parse/enum failures crash downstream Kafka & ERP consumers

tiers.name: Tier 2: Unconstrained Decoding + Client-Side Pydantic Error Retry Loop (Max 3x)
tiers.verdict: 2.8x P99 latency blowup (3,120ms) & +42% retry token waste when schemas fail Pass 1

tiers.name: Tier 3: Answer-First Field Order (`verdict` before `reasoning`) + Uncached Deep FSM
tiers.verdict: 100% valid JSON, but forcing `verdict` on Token #5 before `reasoning` drops accuracy by 16.5 pts!

tiers.name: Tier 4: Pre-Compiled XGrammar/Strict FSM + Reasoning-First Schema Order + Semantic Validator
tiers.verdict: Recommended: 100.0% Pass-1 JSON validity, 96.0% accuracy, 410ms P99 & -86.9% monthly TCO
